title: RF Budget
text: Simulate RF budget chain of 2-port elements in Idealized Baseband simulation environment, 1 input, 1 output; {RF budget source}, {rfbudget object}, {Open RF Budget Analyzer App} sets the rF Budget Analyzer app, {Simulate supported blocks using code generation} sets the simulate model using generated C code, {Edit System} sets the edit or expand RF Budget, {Frequency resolution} and {Modeling bandwidth (Hz)} sets the modeling bandwidth for calculating mismatch loss. Values come from the instance.
